primary_task: Generate a production-ready visual asset (for example a 1024x1024 app icon) through the prompt-to-asset MCP server and save it into the project directory.

requirements.name: prompt-to-asset
requirements.evidence: tools: Read, Write, Bash, mcp__prompt-to-asset ... 4. Use prompt-to-asset to generate the asset, selecting the appropriate model tier
requirements.basis: lacks: "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed"

requirements.name: image-generation-model-providers
requirements.evidence: routing them through the prompt-to-asset MCP server, which spans 30+ image generation models including Stable Diffusion, FLUX, and free-tier providers
requirements.basis: description: "Network egress goes through an allow-list proxy: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused"

requirements.name: prompt-to-asset (npm package)
requirements.evidence: Install prompt-to-asset if not present: npm install -g prompt-to-asset
requirements.basis: tools.bash: "install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)"

requirements.name: read/write/bash
requirements.evidence: tools: Read, Write, Bash; 2. Extract brand context from DESIGN.md, README ... 5. Deliver the asset to the correct project directory
requirements.basis: tools.read: "read files in the working directory"; tools.write: "create and overwrite files"

notes: The deliverable is a generated image file. The MCP server is not a listed connector, and the image models it routes to are external hosts outside the allow-list (also no credentials for model providers). The npm package itself is installable, but installing it does not make it a connected MCP tool nor open egress to the providers. The document's fallback ('if MCP is unavailable, output a detailed prompt the user can paste') is achievable, but it does not produce the asset; if one reads the fallback as an acceptable completion of the task, the verdict would be ACHIEVABLE (degraded). A logo as hand-written SVG would also be possible without the server, but the document routes all generation through prompt-to-asset.
